wire_parameters: The pinned SDK toolWireSchema(tool) converts executable omptype parameters to JSON Schema. Raw executable parameters must never be JSON-stringified as a descriptor.
tool_scope: The native-workspace-v1 exact ten local OMP builtins plus publish_artifact remains unchanged. A current, explicitly bound native browser service may additionally admit exactly the browser tool; an unbound execution remains at eleven tools.

custom_format.definition: Nonempty Lark grammar from the pinned SDK local edit descriptor; bounded by the existing complete model payload size limit.
custom_format.custom_wire_name: Absent or exactly the admitted tool name; no aliases or capability expansion.
custom_format.completion_arguments: Pinned SDK canonical toolCall arguments remain an object, including {input: raw_patch} for custom edit calls.

optional_browser.authority: Only the execution's current owner, computer binding, epoch, accepted browser service and browser lease admit this extra tool. Provider-native computer/browser tools remain denied.
optional_browser.owner_wait: Mutating actions retain the exact original SDK tool-call identity and sealed remaining budget while waiting for the Owner. Unknown effects are not replayed and do not imply successful SDK completion.
optional_browser.acceptance_boundary: Schema admission is not evidence of accepted cold SDK continuation or automatic collaboration.
